resources.string: Plug the Bitaxe in. A brand-new (or reset) unit broadcasts its own Wi-Fi hotspot named Bitaxe_XXXX. Tap Connect, pick that network in the system dialog, and Hashkit will hand the unit your home Wi-Fi and pool — no captive portal, no tiny screen.
This Android version can\'t join the hotspot from inside an app. Join Bitaxe_XXXX from your Wi-Fi settings, then open its setup page.
Waiting for you to pick the Bitaxe_XXXX network…
Connected to the hotspot, but the unit didn\'t answer yet — you can still enter its settings.
Sending settings — the Bitaxe will restart…
Done. The Bitaxe is restarting and joining %1$s.
Your phone returns to its normal Wi-Fi by itself. Give the miner about a minute, then find it on your network.
Your Wi-Fi password is sent only to the Bitaxe over its direct hotspot link and is not stored by Hashkit.
